note: Differential Cypher set. LSQB q1-q9 are the upstream texts (ldbc/lsqb, Apache-2.0) with Post/Comment lowered to Message {kind} and the two NOT-pattern predicates lowered to OPTIONAL MATCH + IS NULL, as the LSQB harness does; a1-a13 are the LSQB count attacks; r* return rows (ordered ones compare in order, the rest as multisets). The oracle is grust-cypher's reference executor over the in-process graph.

queries.cypher:
MATCH (:Country)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(:Person)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(:Message {kind: 'Post'})<-[:REPLY_OF]-(:Message {kind: 'Comment'})-[:HAS_TAG]->(:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(:TagClass)
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH
  (person1:Person)-[:KNOWS]-(person2:Person),
  (person1)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(comment:Message {kind: 'Comment'})-[:REPLY_OF]->(post:Message {kind: 'Post'})-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(person2)
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH (country:Country)
MATCH (person1:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city1:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(country)
MATCH (person2:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city2:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(country)
MATCH (person3:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city3:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(country)
MATCH (person1)-[:KNOWS]-(person2)-[:KNOWS]-(person3)-[:KNOWS]-(person1)
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH (:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(message:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(creator:Person),
  (message)<-[:LIKES]-(liker:Person),
  (message)<-[:REPLY_OF]-(comment:Message {kind: 'Comment'})
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH (tag1:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(message:Message)<-[:REPLY_OF]-(comment:Message {kind: 'Comment'})-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag2:Tag)
WHERE tag1 <> tag2
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH (person1:Person)-[:KNOWS]-(person2:Person)-[:KNOWS]-(person3:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(tag:Tag)
WHERE person1 <> person3
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH (:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(message:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(creator:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (message)<-[:LIKES]-(liker:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (message)<-[:REPLY_OF]-(comment:Message {kind: 'Comment'})
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH (tag1:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(message:Message)<-[:REPLY_OF]-(comment:Message {kind: 'Comment'})-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag2:Tag)
OPTIONAL MATCH (comment)-[h:HAS_TAG]->(tag1)
WITH tag1, tag2, h
WHERE h IS NULL AND tag1 <> tag2
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH (person1:Person)-[:KNOWS]-(person2:Person)-[:KNOWS]-(person3:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(tag:Tag)
OPTIONAL MATCH (person1)-[k:KNOWS]-(person3)
WITH person1, person3, tag, k
WHERE k IS NULL AND person1 <> person3
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH (:TagClass)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(:Message {kind: 'Comment'})-[:REPLY_OF]->(:Message {kind: 'Post'})<-[:CONTAINER_OF]-(:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(:Country)
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH (person:Person)
WHERE 'é' = '\u00e9'
RETURN count(*) AS `résultat_🦀`

MATCH (person:`Person`)
WHERE person.`adversari.al-missing-🧪` IS NULL
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH ()-[edge]->()
RETURN count(edge) AS count

MATCH (post:Message {kind: 'Post'})-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(person2:Person),
      (comment:Message {kind: 'Comment'})-[:REPLY_OF]->(post),
      (comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(person1:Person),
      (person2)-[:KNOWS]-(person1)
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH (:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(message:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(creator:Person)
MATCH (message)<-[:LIKES]-(liker:Person)
MATCH (message)<-[:REPLY_OF]-(comment:Message {kind: 'Comment'})
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH (:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(message:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(creator:Person)
WITH message, creator
OPTIONAL MATCH (message)<-[:LIKES]-(liker:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (message)<-[:REPLY_OF]-(comment:Message)
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH (tag1:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(message:Message)<-[:REPLY_OF]-(comment:Message {kind: 'Comment'})-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag2:Tag)
OPTIONAL MATCH (comment)-[h:HAS_TAG]->(tag1)
WITH tag1, tag2, h
WHERE tag1 <> tag2 AND h IS NULL
RETURN count(*) AS count

UNWIND range(1, 10000) AS i
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH (a:Person), (b:Person), (c:Person)
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN count(*) AS count
UNION
MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH (person:Person)-[:KNOWS*0..0]->(same:Person)
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(q:Person)
RETURN p.id AS a, q.id AS b
ORDER BY a, b
LIMIT 200

MATCH (m:Message {kind: 'Post'})-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)
RETURN p.id AS person, count(m) AS posts
ORDER BY posts DESC, person
LIMIT 50

MATCH (t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(m:Message)
RETURN t.name AS tag, count(*) AS n
ORDER BY n DESC, tag
LIMIT 25

MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE p.gender = 'female'
RETURN p.id AS id, p.firstName AS firstName
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 100

MATCH (c:Message {kind: 'Comment'})-[:REPLY_OF]->(m:Message)
RETURN m.id AS root, count(c) AS replies
ORDER BY replies DESC, root
LIMIT 20

MATCH (p:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(c:Country)
RETURN DISTINCT c.name AS country
ORDER BY country

MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(q:Person)
WHERE p.gender = 'male' AND q.gender = 'female'
RETURN p.id AS a, q.id AS b

MATCH (:Officer)-[:OFFICER_OF]->(:Entity)
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH (:Entity)-[:REGISTERED_ADDRESS]->(:Address)
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH (:Intermediary)-[:INTERMEDIARY_OF]->(:Entity)-[:REGISTERED_ADDRESS]->(:Address)
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH (o:Officer)-[:OFFICER_OF]->(:Entity)<-[:OFFICER_OF]-(p:Officer)
WHERE o <> p
RETURN count(*) AS count

MATCH ()-[e]->()
RETURN count(e) AS count

MATCH (o:Officer)-[:OFFICER_OF]->(e:Entity)
RETURN o.id AS officer, count(e) AS entities
ORDER BY entities DESC, officer
LIMIT 50

MATCH (e:Entity)
WHERE e.jurisdiction = 'SAM'
RETURN e.id AS id, e.name AS name
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 100

MATCH (e:Entity)-[:REGISTERED_ADDRESS]->(a:Address)
RETURN a.id AS address, count(e) AS entities
ORDER BY entities DESC, address
LIMIT 25

MATCH (e:Entity)
RETURN DISTINCT e.jurisdiction AS jurisdiction
ORDER BY jurisdiction
